Your finely honed agility and alertness has given you the uncanny ability to scrape through otherwise deadly situations. 

Quick Escape

If an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to add +2 to your AC. If this causes the attack to miss, you take no damage and can immediately Disengage and move up to half your speed.

Evasive Maneuver

When making a Dexterity (Save) check to take half damage from an effect, you instead take no damage when you would take half damage, and half damage when you would take full damage.
